source: ESPN fantasy league 1260678264 (2022) box scores, processed by convert_espn_2022_starters.py; raw dumps not committed.
rules: Starters = every lineup slot except bench and IR. pts = ESPN fantasy points (0.5 PPR). td / yds = actual NFL stats (zeros omitted); return = kick/punt return TDs + fumble-recovery TDs by offensive players. D/ST TDs are not counted. Playoff rounds are two weeks; each scoring period (week) is its own row.
checks: Starter points sum to ESPN's weekly team score for all 136 team-weeks and match espn_2022_games.json.
